name: socialweb-computer
description: socialweb-computer: one multi-call binary whose subcommand tree is the stack

host-backend.description: Placement backend for long-lived host processes: systemd-user (installs) or proc (dev, tests). Required: no default, never probed

instance.description: Application instance id (dev: derived from the worktree when unset)

state-dir.description: State root; resolved by install or dev, no default here

instance-dir.description: State directory of one application instance (the dev core reads its instance.json there)

kcp-base-workspace.description: Workspace every role addresses its objects under

asset-cache.description: Extraction root of embedded assets (dev: the per-user $XDG_CACHE_HOME/socialweb-computer/runtime when unset)

source-root.description: dev builds: the socialweb-computer-kcp checkout whose TypeScript runs (holds deno.json and deploy/ts-entries.yaml); unset walks up from the working directory, then the executable's. Release builds have no such option and run the embedded closure

asset-gc-window.description: dev gc: an asset dir used within this window is kept (Go duration)

profile.description: Dev profile: quick (kine on sqlite + one kcp slot), prodlike (the gateway shape: a postgres unit, one kine per kcp slot on it, blue/green slots a and b behind the front) or market-network (a quick-shaped instance whose MarketNetwork root object runs the shared atproto services and composes child applications, each with its own kcp)

bidders.description: dev up --profile market-network: how many MarketBidder child applications the network composes (bidder-1 .. bidder-N), each with its own kcp

with-gateway.description: dev up --profile market-network: also compose a Gateway child application with its own kcp

app-values.description: dev up --profile market-network: a YAML file merged over deploy/apps/market-network/market-network.values.yaml (keys bidder and gateway: the NetworkApp fields every bidder or the gateway gets, e.g. bidder.firecracker)

network-timeout.description: dev up --profile market-network: how long dev up waits for the MarketNetwork and every child application to report Ready (Go duration)

parent.description: dev up: the dev host instance (dev host; dev-host by default there) whose kcp holds this instance's bootstrap units as HostProcess objects in root:dev:<instance>, placed by the parent's supervisor; unset runs the instance under its own devsup

postgres-root.description: dev up: absolute root of the extracted postgres asset tree (versions.json postgres) that runs kcp's store in prodlike and every Postgres object (dev build: explicit, never PATH; a release build extracts its embedded postgres)

stand-ins.description: dev up: a JSON file naming the units to place instead of a profile's bootstrap layer, in order ([{role, exec, env, listens}]); the instance then has no kcp (tests place stand-ins this way)

kcp-path.description: Absolute path of the kcp release executable (dev build: explicit, never PATH; units roll kcp: the target asset, unset keeps the current one)

kine-path.description: Absolute path of the kine executable (dev build: explicit, never PATH; units roll kcp: the target asset, unset keeps the current one)

bao-path.description: Absolute path of the OpenBao bao executable an OpenBaoServer with asset bao runs (dev build: explicit, never PATH, optional; a release build extracts its embedded bao)

deno-path.description: Absolute path of the pinned deno the core runs every DenoPod on (dev build: explicit, never PATH; a release build extracts its embedded deno)

openbao-addr.description: dev up: URL of the OpenBao server the core's deno runtime provisions OpenBao namespaces in and issues DenoPod serving certificates from (unset: DenoPods serve plain HTTP)

openbao-token-file.description: dev up: absolute path of the file holding the token for openbao-addr

ready-timeout.description: How long dev up waits for kcp /readyz (Go duration)

owner.description: internal apiserver-front: the application instance (or cluster) whose front this is

kcp-front-address.description: Listen address of kcp's L4 front: dev and bidders pass 127.0.0.1:0 (the port is read back); only the gateway's prod config.json sets 127.0.0.1:6443

front-control.description: internal apiserver-front: the control socket the core sets the backend through (under 108 bytes)

front-state.description: internal apiserver-front: the file holding the chosen backend across front restarts

front-fd-store.description: internal apiserver-front: hand the listening socket to the service manager's fd store (NOTIFY_SOCKET) and take it back from LISTEN_FDS

keep-state.description: dev down: keep the instance state directory

fg.description: dev up: keep the instance bound to this terminal; devsup dies with dev up and Ctrl-C is dev down

binary.description: dev restart core and upgrade: absolute path of the socialweb-computer executable to run next (dev restart: this executable when unset)

tail.description: dev logs: print only the last N lines (0 prints the whole log)

state.description: internal devsup: the supervisor state directory

socket.description: internal devsup: the unix socket path (under 108 bytes)

die-with.description: internal devsup and dev up: stop every unit and exit when this pid exits (0 = never; a test passes its own pid)

clusterprovider-advertise-address.description: Address tenant nodes dial for the cluster control plane

clusterprovider-audit-policy.description: Audit policy file for tenant apiservers

clusterprovider-datastore-has-row.description: The tenant datastore already holds rows (skip the fresh-store check)

clusterprovider-node-agent.description: Path of the node agent executable

container-account.description: Account handle of the container-era bootstrap

container-account-did.description: Account DID of the container-era bootstrap

container-door.description: Door mode of the container-era entrypoint

container-door-port.description: Door listen port (edge; no default here)

container-home.description: Home workspace of the container-era bootstrap

container-kcp-bind.description: kcp bind address of the container-era entrypoint

container-tls-port.description: TLS listen port (edge; no default here)

device-key.description: Device key handed to the credential exec plugin

gateway-device-key-exec-env-name.description: Env name the exec plugin reads the device key from

gateway-device-key-max-ttl.description: Upper bound of a device-key credential TTL

gateway-public-mint-url.description: Public URL of the credential mint

kubectl.description: Path of kubectl (replaced by kcpapply, M1-HOST-INVENTORY)

set.description: apply, manifests render: the manifest sets, comma-separated, in order (manifests list names them)

values.description: apply, manifests render: a YAML or JSON file of typed values keyed by set name, decoded strictly

dry-run.description: apply: server-side dry run; reports every field whose manager would change and persists nothing. install: print the computed step list and change nothing

phase.description: apply, manifests render: only these phases of each set, comma-separated names or first..last ranges in set order

wait-timeout.description: apply: how long each typed wait may take (Go duration)

handle.description: install bidder: the atproto handle(s) of the bidder instances, comma-separated; a re-run with another handle adds that instance. internal vm: the one bidder instance whose VMs these are. units roll kcp: the one bidder handle whose kcp restarts (unset: the gateway)

vm-runtime-dir.description: internal vm: the account's runtime dir; each VM's API socket lives under <dir>/swvm

guest-image-source.description: internal vm: file:// or https:// base the pinned guest image (vmlinux, rootfs.ext4, image.json) is fetched from once and verified by sha256

vm-stop-grace.description: internal vm: how long a stop waits after SendCtrlAltDel before SIGKILL (Go duration; x86_64 only, arm64 kills at once)

userns-stage-path.description: Absolute path of swc-userns-stage (dev build: explicit, never PATH)

pasta-path.description: Absolute path of the pinned pasta (dev build: explicit, never PATH)

vmexec-path.description: Absolute path of socialweb-vmexec (dev build: explicit, never PATH)

firecracker-path.description: Absolute path of the pinned firecracker (dev build: explicit, never PATH)

account.description: install/uninstall: the system account (socialweb for a gateway, swc-bidder for bidders when unset)

vm-slots.description: install bidder: VM slots of 65536 subordinate ids reserved in /etc/subuid and /etc/subgid

adopt-account.description: install: take over an existing account no install record names (never needed for an account install created)

purge.description: uninstall: also remove the state dir (vault, kcp store, keys) and the account install created

force.description: uninstall: proceed while VM units are active (each stopped VM becomes Lost)

sha256.description: upgrade: the published sha256 of --binary; a mismatch is refused

planned-outage.description: units roll kcp: stop the old slot before the new one starts (the only path for a kcp pair without a storage-compatible kcpCompat record)

unit-prefix.description: units roll kcp: the unit name prefix of the installed application (a test placement; socialweb- when unset)

private-hostname.description: internal ns-exec: the UTS hostname the command runs under, in its own user+UTS+mount namespace

bind.description: internal ns-exec: comma-separated <source>:<target> directories bind-mounted in the command's mount namespace (a target that does not exist is skipped)

inside.description: internal ns-exec: the second stage, already inside the namespaces unshare made

cluster-state-dir.description: units roll cluster|link: the cluster provider's state dir, holding each cluster's controlplane.json

k3s-path.description: units roll cluster: the k3s executable the new slot runs (unset: the one the active slot runs)

dumbpipe-path.description: units roll link: the dumbpipe executable the replacement listener runs (unset: the one the link runs)

service.description: units roll link: the link to replace, apiserver or openbao

idle-bound.description: units roll cluster: how long a swap waits for no non-kube-system pod Running on a market node before it proceeds anyway (Go duration)
